s2.ptxt: Secure the cooler compressor assembly in a vise with aluminum plates.
Install the magnetic clutch stator aligned with the position on the cooler compressor assembly shown in the illustration.
Using SST, install a new snap ring with its chamfered side facing up.
Connect the ground wire with the screw and install the bracket.
Install the magnetic clutch rotor to the cooler compressor assembly.
Using SST, install a new snap ring with its chamfered side facing up.

item.ptxt: When installing the snap ring, do not expand its inner diameter by more than φ35.5mm.
When installing the snap ring, do not damage the seal cover of the bearing.

s2.ptxt: Temporarily install the magnetic clutch washers and magnetic clutch hub to the cooler compressor assembly with the bolt.

atten3.ptxt: Do not change the combination of magnetic clutch washers from that before disassembly.

s2.ptxt: Using vise pliers, hold the magnetic clutch hub and fully tighten the bolt.

item.ptxt: Use a shop rag or equivalent so as not to damage the clutch hub.
When tightening the bolt, do not allow oil or other foreign matter to adhere to the tip and threads of the compressor shaft, the bolt seat surface and threads, or the clutch hub seat surface.

s2.ptxt: Set a dial indicator perpendicular to the magnetic clutch hub.
Connect battery positive (+) to terminal 3 of the magnetic clutch connector and battery negative (-) to the ground wire, turn the magnetic clutch ON and OFF, and measure the air gap when it is OFF.
If it is not within the standard, remove the magnetic clutch hub and adjust by changing the number of magnetic clutch washers

atten3.ptxt: Perform adjustment using 3 or fewer magnetic clutch washers.

s2.ptxt: Remove the cooler compressor w/ magnetic clutch assembly from the vise.

When replacing with a new cooler compressor assembly, gradually release the inert gas (helium) from the service valve, then drain the amount of oil shown below from the position indicated by the arrow in the illustration before installation.

atten4.ptxt: The drain bolt (washer) can be reused.

specitem.ptxt: (Oil capacity in new cooler compressor assembly 90 (+15) mL) - (Remaining oil in removed cooler compressor assembly) = (Amount to drain when replacing)

item.ptxt: When checking the compressor oil amount, strictly observe the precautions for removal and installation.

Because compressor oil remains in the vehicle piping, if a new cooler compressor assembly is installed without draining oil from it, the oil amount will increase and interfere with heat exchange in the refrigerant cycle, which may cause poor cooling performance or adverse effects such as noise and vibration.
If the amount of oil remaining in the removed cooler compressor assembly is small, inspect for oil leaks.
